# The 0.9.0 control log, migrated

`control.db` is `control-0.9.0/control.db` migrated to format 2 by this release's `ControlStore`, written by the ignored test `store::write_the_migrated_fixture` in `tests/control/store.rs`. `scripts/write-control-fixtures.sh stray` opens a copy of it with 0.9.0's code; it is never regenerated.
